title: Extreme Cold Climate Maximum Wall U-Value
explanation: Wall thermal transmittance must not exceed 0.45 W/m2K in sub-zero alpine regions to prevent hypothermia risk.

title: Mandatory Roof Thermal Resistance
explanation: Roof R-value must be at least 2.50 m2K/W to prevent massive conductive heat loss through building ceiling.

title: North Wall Maximum Window-to-Wall Ratio
explanation: North glazing should not exceed 10% of north wall area to limit severe cold infiltration and radiation loss.

title: Total Opening Area Geometrical Bound
explanation: Total opening penetrations must strictly not exceed gross wall boundary area.

title: Cold-Climate Air Infiltration Limit
explanation: Uncontrolled infiltration rate must remain at or below 0.5 ACH to preserve indoor stored thermal energy.
